x-pages.title: Introduction
x-pages.content:
# Swagger Petstore API

Welcome to the **Swagger Petstore** developer documentation and API reference. This service provides endpoints to manage pets in inventory, retrieve detailed pet information, and track pet orders.

## Overview

The Petstore API is built using modern REST conventions and specifications:
- Standard HTTP status codes (`200 OK`, `201 Created`, `204 No Content`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found`, etc.)
- JSON-encoded request and response bodies
- Resource-oriented URLs

## Base URL

All requests are served over HTTPS relative to the following base endpoint:

```bash
https://petstore.swagger.io/v1
```

> **Note:** For quick testing in local development or sandboxes, you can explore the interactive endpoint tester in this documentation viewer!

## Quick Start Example

Retrieve all available pets in the store with an optional limit:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://petstore.swagger.io/v1/pets?limit=10" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

Sample JSON response:

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Fido",
    "tag": "dog"
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "name": "Whiskers",
    "tag": "cat"
  }
]
```

# Registration & API Authentication

Learn how to create your developer account and obtain credentials to access the Petstore API.

## 1. Developer Registration

To create an account:

1. Visit the [Petstore Developer Portal](https://petstore.swagger.io) and click **Sign Up**.
2. Provide your work email address and password.
3. Verify your email address via the confirmation link.

## 2. Generating an API Key

Once your account is registered:

- Navigate to **Dashboard** → **API Keys**.
- Click **Create New Key** and assign a descriptive label (e.g. `Development Laptop`).
- Copy your API secret key immediately. For security, it will not be displayed again.

## 3. Using Your API Key

Include your API key as a custom header in all authenticated HTTP requests:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://petstore.swagger.io/v1/pets" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY_HERE"
```

```javascript
fetch("https://petstore.swagger.io/v1/pets", {
  headers: {
    "X-API-Key": "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
    "Accept": "application/json"
  }
});
```

### Rate Limiting

- **Free Tier:** 100 requests per minute
- **Production Tier:** 5,000 requests per minute

If you exceed the rate limit, the API returns HTTP status `429 Too Many Requests`.
